title: Glory Jesus glory

lines.text: You do the fighting for me.
Ye are of God little children
For greater is He that is in You
Than He that is in the world.
When He shall appear in glory.

lyrics:
[Verse]

Glory Jesus Glory

You do the fighting for me.

Praise you Jesus, praise You,

In You, there''s always victory.

Ye are of God little children

And have overcome them,

For greater is He that is in You

Than He that is in the world.

Abide in Him little children,

That when He shall appear,

We shall be like Him

When He shall appear in glory.
